var reads = 0;

Future<bool> isFree(int id) async {
  reads += 1;
  await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 5));
  return id == 3;
}

// CASE multi_decl_return expect=pass
Future<int> firstFree(List<int> ids) async {
  for (var i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++) {
    if (await isFree(ids[i])) return ids[i];
  }
  return -1;
}

// CASE reverse_return expect=pass
Future<int> lastFree(List<int> ids) async {
  for (var i = ids.length; i-- > 0;) {
    if (await isFree(ids[i])) return ids[i];
  }
  return -1;
}

// CASE single_return_control expect=pass
Future<int> firstFreeSingle(List<int> ids) async {
  for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
    if (await isFree(ids[i])) return ids[i];
  }
  return -1;
}

// CASE harness expect=pass
Future<void> main() async {
  final ids = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6];
  final a = await firstFree(ids);
  final readsA = reads;
  reads = 0;
  final b = await lastFree(ids);
  final readsB = reads;
  print('firstFree=$a reads=$readsA lastFree=$b reads=$readsB');
  if (a != 3 || readsA != 3 || b != 3 || readsB != 4)
    throw StateError('unexpected');
}
